behavior: trusted baseline required before any event applies; baseline clears holds for that scope only
sequential completed events apply through src/lifecycle consumeCapabilityEvent; duplicate applied events are idempotent
generation gap, late generation, partial/outcome_unknown, unregistered scope, store failure all create a visible hold and are not applied
optional getScopeState recheck refuses producer-state mismatch; no fake Host method is assumed
held scope pauses admission (resolveScope) and recall injection via isScopeHeld
cursors/holds/event log are persisted in catalog v2 tables, so restart/replay cannot silently advance
tests: tests/plugin-entry.test.mjs status assertion (capability field not yet asserted)
limitations: The real 03-session-management producer/outbox is not implemented in this repository; the optional capability/event Host bus listener is a future transport seam and has no live emitter.
No real Host/03 event was consumed; fixtures and temporary stores are the evidence.
A held scope has no automatic resume until a trusted baseline/getScopeState adapter exists; the small bar/status reports the phase but no management resume UI is added.
